capabilities: Sync edits of a tagged section to every other instance of that section in the note
Auto-fill a bare section marker with the nearest existing instance's content
Attach inline bar content (chords, key, capo) to section markers and sync it
Mark sections as local-only or as exception tags that sync chords but not lyrics
Optionally color section blocks and use explicit closing tags
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The only command logs section markers to the developer console, which is a debugging aid.
problem: Obsidian has no way to keep repeated song sections like choruses in sync within a note, so editing one instance leaves the others stale.
summary: Song helper that keeps tagged song sections (Chorus, Verse, Bridge) synchronized across a note when any instance is edited.
